sections.title: 一、阅读理解 A
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，从各题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
# Discover the Secrets of Chinese Food

Do you love Chinese food and want to learn how to cook it yourself? Join our cooking classes at Plate Kitchen and learn how to recreate your favourite Chinese food.

From Mapo tofu to fried rice, our expert cooks will guide you step by step to create the delicious Chinese dishes. Along the way, you will pick up useful cooking tips and have a chance to ask the cook any questions you might have. And the best part? You can get to enjoy the delicious food you have made after each class!

# Who Can Join?
This activity is for people who live in the West Community. For safety reasons, participants (参加者) must be 12 years old or older.

# Time
Classes are held every Friday and Saturday from 3:30 p.m. to 6:30 p.m.

# Pricing
One ticket costs 100 dollars. You can buy a second ticket at half price!

# What's Included?
All cooking ingredients (食材), kitchen tools, and a cookbook are provided, and the book is yours to take home.

Whether you are a beginner or an experienced cook, this class is perfect for anyone who wants to learn the art of Chinese cooking. For more information, please call us at 686-3120. We look forward to cooking with you!

questions.prompt: What can you do at Plate Kitchen?
options: Know the types of Chinese food.
questions.translation: 你可以在 Plate Kitchen 做什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第1段 'learn how to recreate your favourite Chinese food' 可知，可以在那里学习制作中国美食。故选 Learn to make Chinese food.。

questions.prompt: Who can take the cooking class?
options: A doctor who lives in the East Community.
A working mom, only free on Sundays.
A teacher living in the West Community.
questions.translation: 谁可以参加烹饪课程？
questions.explanation: 根据 Who Can Join? 部分 'for people who live in the West Community... must be 12 years old or older' 可知，住在西社区且年满12岁的教师符合条件。故选 A teacher living in the West Community.。

questions.prompt: How much should you pay if you join the class with your mother?
questions.translation: 如果你和母亲一起参加课程，应该付多少钱？
questions.explanation: 根据 Pricing 部分 'One ticket costs 100 dollars. You can buy a second ticket at half price!' 可知，第一张票100美元，第二张票半价50美元，两人合计150美元。故选 150 dollars.。

questions.prompt: Where is the article probably from?
questions.translation: 这篇文章可能来自哪里？
questions.explanation: 通读全文可知这是一则面向西社区居民的烹饪课程招生通知，最可能出现在社区布告栏（community noticeboard）上。故选 A community noticeboard.。

sections.title: 二、阅读理解 B
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，从各题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
When I was in Grade Eight, our physics (物理) teacher gave us a challenge to make a paper plane of any shape. The only goal was to get it to fly as far as possible. I had a lot of skills in making paper planes, so I made the best plane I could, and it flew pretty far.

One boy called Eric made the simplest paper plane. He stood there at the starting line with a normal piece of paper. A minute later, he took the flat piece of paper, made it into a ball, and threw it down the hallway (走廊). We were so surprised at what he did. We never expected things to happen like that. He beat all of us easily.

Some of the students got angry and Mary even said that he cheated (作弊).

The physics teacher said, "How so? He doesn't do anything wrong because a paper ball is indeed (确实) a shape. I like his idea."

Yes, Eric didn't cheat. He just finished the task in a different way. In our life, what we have learned turns into our experience. We do everything according to it. However, our experience gets in the way of our development sometimes. <u>It</u> stops us from coming up with new ideas and is bad for our creativity. So it is really necessary for us to learn to think outside of the "box". Then we may think of more and easier ways so that we can have a better result. Just like Eric in the story, we should think creatively.

questions.prompt: What's the challenge in physics class?
options: Give a report about paper planes.
Make a paper plane of any shape.
Learn skills in making paper planes.
questions.translation: 物理课上的挑战是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第1段第一句 'our physics teacher gave us a challenge to make a paper plane of any shape.' 可知是制作任意形状的纸飞机。故选 Make a paper plane of any shape.。

questions.prompt: What did the teacher think of Eric?
questions.translation: 老师觉得埃里克怎么样？
questions.explanation: 根据第4段老师说 'He doesn't do anything wrong because a paper ball is indeed a shape. I like his idea.' 以及文章最后总结 'we should think creatively' 可知老师认为埃里克很有创造力（creative）。故选 Creative.。

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word "<u>It</u>" in the last paragraph refer to?
questions.translation: 最后一段划线单词“<u>It</u>”指代什么？
questions.explanation: 根据前一句 'However, our experience gets in the way of our development sometimes. It stops us from coming up with new ideas...' 可知 It 指代前句的主语 our experience（我们的经验）。故选 Our experience.。

questions.prompt: What is the text mainly about?
questions.translation: 这篇文章主要讲什么？
questions.explanation: 文章通过埃里克揉纸团扔飞机的启发，说明不能受思维定势限制，要打破常规、学会创造性思考（ways of thinking）。故选 The ways of thinking.。

sections.title: 三、阅读理解 C
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，从各题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Chen Yuxuan, a 16-year-old student from Shenzhen Middle School, has won the top prize at the International Youth Science Competition for his invention "Smart Plant Box". His device (装置) helps plants grow better in cities using solar power and AI technology.

Chen's invention can automatically (自动地) offer water and nutrients (营养物) to plants based on their needs. It uses sensors (传感器) to check soil conditions and a small computer to analyze (分析) the data. The box costs about 500 yuan to make but can increase plant growth by 40%. "I want to help make cities greener," Chen said. "Many people live in apartments without gardens, but everyone can grow plants with this box."

The young inventor spent two years developing his project. He failed over 20 times before succeeding. His science teacher, Mr. Zhang, said: "Chen doesn't stop easily when facing problems. He always tries again and often works in the lab until very late to make his invention better." Besides, Chen's parents supported his research by turning their balcony (阳台) into a testing area.

Over 1,000 students from 50 countries joined the competition. It even won international attention. The judges (裁判员) praised Chen's invention, "It can be widely used in daily life and it is environmentally friendly." Shenzhen Government has promised to support more young inventors like Chen.

Chen plans to improve his invention and hopes to study environmental science at university. "I believe technology can help solve environmental problems," he told reporters.

questions.prompt: How does Chen Yuxuan's invention help plants grow?
options: By making them get more sunlight.
By moving them to better soil.
questions.translation: 陈宇轩的发明是如何帮助植物生长的？
questions.explanation: 根据第2段第一句 'Chen's invention can automatically offer water and nutrients to plants based on their needs.' 可知，该装置根据植物需求自动提供水分和养分（providing what they need）。故选 By providing what they need.。

questions.prompt: What makes Chen successful most?
options: His spirit of never giving up.
questions.translation: 陈宇轩成功的最大原因是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第3段 'He failed over 20 times before succeeding. His science teacher, Mr. Zhang, said: "Chen doesn't stop easily when facing problems. He always tries again..."' 可知，永不放弃的精神是他成功的最关键因素。故选 His spirit of never giving up.。

questions.prompt: Why did the judges like Chen's invention?
options: It was cheap and easy to make.
questions.translation: 裁判员为什么喜欢陈宇轩的发明？
questions.explanation: 根据第4段 'The judges praised Chen's invention, "It can be widely used in daily life and it is environmentally friendly."' 可知，发明非常实用（practical）且环保（environmentally friendly / green）。故选 It was practical and green.。

questions.prompt: What does Chen plan to do next?
options: Start a company to sell his invention.
Help his teacher with other projects.
Teach other students how to invent things.
Make his invention better and study science.
questions.translation: 陈宇轩下一步计划做什么？
questions.explanation: 根据最后一段 'Chen plans to improve his invention and hopes to study environmental science at university.' 可知，他计划改进这项发明并去大学学习环境科学。故选 Make his invention better and study science.。

sections.title: 四、阅读理解 D
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，从各题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
① Almost all animals need to sleep to stay healthy. But sleeping can be dangerous because other animals may hunt sleeping animals. To help them stay safe, animals have many different ways of sleeping. Some of these ways may surprise you!

② Some seabirds can sleep while they fly. These large birds spend most of their lives over the ocean. They are in danger on the water, but they are safe in the air. They glide (滑行) for many hours without moving their wings up and down. Sometimes they sleep while they glide.

③ A dolphin sleeps with just half its brain at a time. It must stay awake to breathe and to watch for danger. Dolphins can swim without sleep for two months to stay safe. Ducks sleep with just half their brains, too. These ducks often sleep in a line. The ducks at both ends help keep the group safe. They keep one eye open to watch for danger. The ducks in the middle sleep with both eyes closed.

④ Seals breathe air, but that doesn't stop them from sleeping underwater. They hold their breath and dive deep to sleep for up to twenty minutes at a time. Some fish make their own sleeping bags. They make a big bubble and sleep inside it. It also keeps other animals from smelling them. If an animal hits the bubble, the fish swims away quickly.

questions.prompt: Why do animals have different ways of sleeping?
options: To make themselves stay away from danger.
questions.translation: 动物为什么有不同的睡觉方式？
questions.explanation: 根据第1段 'To help them stay safe, animals have many different ways of sleeping.' 可知动物为了在睡觉时躲避危险、保证安全而采取不同的睡觉方式。故选 To make themselves stay away from danger.。

questions.prompt: How do seabirds sleep?
questions.translation: 海鸟是如何睡觉的？
questions.explanation: 根据第2段最后两句 'They glide for many hours without moving their wings up and down. Sometimes they sleep while they glide.' 可知它们在空中滑行时睡觉。故选 By gliding in the air.。

questions.prompt: What will happen if an animal hits the bubbles of fish?
options: The fish will make sleeping bags.
The fish will smell other animals.
questions.translation: 如果有动物碰到鱼的气泡会发生什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第4段最后一句 'If an animal hits the bubble, the fish swims away quickly.' 可知鱼会迅速游走逃跑（run away）。故选 The fish will run away.。

sections.title: 五、阅读还原
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从方框内所给的选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项，其中有一个多余的选项。
sections.passage:
From January 30 to February 3, Beijing's first AI temple fair (庙会) was held in Haidian District. It showed how AI could be part of traditional celebrations.

At the temple fair, people experienced special activities. And some enjoyed food provided by a robot. [1]

At the main venue of the temple fair, crowds of people watched a robot band perform "Dance of the Golden Snakes". [2] They gave a wonderful performance together.

At another area of the fair, a robot wrote the Chinese character Fu on a piece of red square paper. People also enjoyed a number of other robot shows. [3] The children watched robots play football and competed with a robot in doing push-ups. They even played chess with another robot.

The temple fair gave people the chance to experience the latest AI technological achievements. [4]
wordbank: Foreigners like the temple fair very much.
Many children were interested in the event, too.
Some of them bought drinks from a robot shopping helper.
It also encouraged young people to learn more about technology.
To everyone's surprise, the band worked with two human musicians.

questions.translation: 在庙会上，人们体验了特别的活动。有些人品尝了机器人提供的食物。他们中有些人从机器人导购助手那里购买了饮料。
questions.explanation: 前句讲到有人享用了机器人提供的食物（food），选项 'Some of them bought drinks from a robot shopping helper.'（有些人从机器人售货员那里买了饮品）承接食物饮品话题。故选 'Some of them bought drinks from a robot shopping helper.'。

questions.translation: 在庙会主会场，成群的人观看了机器人乐队演奏《金蛇狂舞》。让大家惊讶的是，这支乐队还与两位人类音乐家合作。他们一起带来了精彩的演出。
questions.explanation: 前句提到 robot band（机器人乐队），后句提到 'They gave a wonderful performance together.'（他们一起奉献了精彩演出），选项 'To everyone's surprise, the band worked with two human musicians.' 完美衔接乐队与后文的 together。故选 'To everyone's surprise, the band worked with two human musicians.'。

questions.translation: 人们还欣赏了许多其他机器人表演。许多孩子也对这个活动很感兴趣。孩子们看机器人踢足球，还和机器人比拼做俯卧撑。
questions.explanation: 后句具体列举了 'The children watched robots play football...'，选项 'Many children were interested in the event, too.' 引出孩子们参与活动的话题。故选 'Many children were interested in the event, too.'。

questions.translation: 庙会让人们有机会体验最新的AI科技成果。它也鼓励年轻人更多地了解科学技术。
questions.explanation: 前句讲到庙会带给人们体验最新科技成果的机会，选项 'It also encouraged young people to learn more about technology.' 作为总结句，进一步说明科技庙会的深远意义。故选 'It also encouraged young people to learn more about technology.'。

sections.title: 六、完形填空
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，从各题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Years ago, a farmer owned land near the sea. He always needed workers to help him, but most people did not want to work on farms near the sea. They were [1] of the terrible storms (暴风雨) that often hit and destroyed (毁坏) buildings and plants. Finally, a short man came to the farmer, "Are you a good worker?" the farmer asked him. "Well, I can sleep when the wind [2]," answered the little man. Although the farmer was surprised by this answer, he still gave him the job because he really needed [3]. The little man worked very hard on the farm, and the farmer felt [4] with his work.

Then one night the wind blew loudly in from the sea. Jumping out of bed, the farmer [5] to the short man's room. The farmer shouted, "[6]! A storm is coming! Tie things down before they are blown away!" But the little man lay in bed [7] and said, "No, sir. I told you I can sleep when the wind blows."

Hearing the words, the farmer hurried outside to prepare for the [8] on his own. To his surprise, he found that everything was tied down and nothing could be blown away. The farmer then [9] what the short man's words meant, so he returned to his bed to sleep while the wind was blowing.

When you get [10], you have nothing to worry about. Can you sleep when the wind blows through your life?

questions.translation: 他们害怕经常袭击并摧毁房屋和庄稼的可怕暴风雨。
questions.explanation: be afraid of 意为“害怕，恐惧”，与暴风雨造成破坏语境吻合。故选 afraid。

questions.translation: “嗯，起风的时候我能睡着，”这个小个子男人回答道。
questions.explanation: 根据后文反复出现的原话 'I told you I can sleep when the wind blows.' 可知此处为 blows。故选 blows。

questions.translation: 尽管农夫对这个回答很惊讶，但他还是录用了他，因为他真的很需要人手帮工。
questions.explanation: 根据前文 'He always needed workers to help him' 可知农夫急需人手帮助（help）。故选 help。

questions.translation: 矮个子在农场干活非常卖力，农夫对他的工作感到很满意。
questions.explanation: be pleased with 意为“对……感到满意”，与前句 'worked very hard' 形成因果。故选 pleased。

questions.translation: 农夫从床上跳起来，跑向矮个子的房间。
questions.explanation: 暴风雨来临时情况危急，农夫跑（ran）去叫醒工人。故选 ran。

questions.translation: 农夫喊道：“快起床！暴风雨要来了！”
questions.explanation: Get up 意为“起床”，催促睡觉的人起来应对暴风雨。故选 Get up。

questions.translation: 但是小个子男人懒洋洋地躺在床上说……
questions.explanation: 根据 'lay in bed' 以及后面的回答，说明他悠闲镇定、懒懒地躺着没有着急。故选 lazily。

questions.translation: 听了这些话，农夫急忙跑到外面独自准备应对暴风雨。
questions.explanation: prepare for the storm 意为“为暴风雨做准备”。故选 storm。

questions.translation: 农夫这时明白了那个矮个子男人话里的意思。
questions.explanation: understand what... meant 意为“明白……的意思”。故选 understood。

questions.translation: 当你做好充分准备时，你就没有什么好担心的了。
questions.explanation: get ready 意为“做好准备”，点明全文寓意——未雨绸缪，做好准备才能高枕无忧。故选 ready。

sections.title: 七、语篇填空
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，在空白处填入1个适当的单词或括号内单词的正确形式。
sections.passage:
What's team spirit (精神)? Team spirit means the will of people to work together and help each other as part of a team. With this spirit, people try hard [1] (make) their team the [2] (good) of all. It is quite often that one is not able to carry out a job by [3] (he). He needs more people to finish it together. China has an old saying, "Unity (团结) is strength", which means the [4] (important) of teamwork. [5] there is no team spirit, a group of people won't be a whole unit.

Anyone can show team spirit just by showing support for the goal. It means we should train our ability to work with others. [6] fact, the ability is based on our heart. Therefore, we must learn to work well in the team and let the team spirit lead us to [7] (succeed). How can we work with others very well? The following three tips are the most helpful ones. First, be honest with others. [8] (two), be modest (谦虚的) enough. And [9] (final), don't be selfish. All in all, team spirit is [10] important ability and skill nowadays. Let's work hard to develop it for a brighter future.

questions.translation: 有了这种精神，人们努力让自己的团队成为最好的团队。
questions.explanation: try hard to do sth. 为固定搭配，意为“努力去做某事”，后接动词不定式。故选 to make。

questions.translation: 让他们的团队成为所有团队中最好的。
questions.explanation: 根据 'the... of all' 可知应用最高级 the best。故选 best。

questions.translation: 一个人经常无法独自完成一项工作。
questions.explanation: by oneself 为固定搭配，意为“独自，靠自己”，主语为 one/he，对应反身代词 himself。故选 himself。

questions.translation: 中国有句老话，“团结就是力量”，这说明了团队合作的重要性。
questions.explanation: 冠词 the 后面需接名词形式，important 的名词形式为 importance。故选 importance。

questions.translation: 如果没有团队精神，一群人就无法成为一个整体。
questions.explanation: 此处引导条件状语从句，意为“如果”，首字母大写为 If。故选 If。

questions.translation: 事实上，这种能力源于我们的内心。
questions.explanation: in fact 为固定短语，意为“事实上”，位于句首首字母大写。故选 In。

questions.translation: 让团队精神引领我们走向成功。
questions.explanation: lead sb. to sth. 中 to 为介词，后接名词 success。故选 success。

questions.translation: 第二，要足够谦虚。
questions.explanation: 与前文 'First' 以及后文 'And finally' 相对应，此处表示列举的第二点，应用序数词 Second 或副词 Secondly，首选与 First 并列的 Second。故选 Second。

questions.translation: 最后，不要自私。
questions.explanation: 修饰整个句子作状语应用副词形式 finally。故选 finally。

questions.translation: 总而言之，如今团队精神是一项重要的能力和技能。
questions.explanation: ability 为可数名词单数，且 important 以元音音素开头，前面用不定冠词 an。故选 an。

sections.title: 八、任务型阅读
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从各题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Sun Yingsha is a famous Chinese table tennis player. She was born on November 4th, 2000 in Shijiazhuang, Hebei. As one of the top players in the world, she represents (代表) the Chinese national table tennis team.

Sun Yingsha has shown her great talent and hard work in many important table tennis events. In the 2024 Paris Olympics, she had an excellent performance. She won two gold medals (奖牌) and one silver medal. One of the gold medals was from the mixed double event, which was the first ever mixed doubles gold for China in the Olympics. She also represented Asian players and blew out the Olympic fire at the closing ceremony (仪式), which made her famous around the world.

She has two interesting names. People call her "Little Devil" (小魔王) because of her excellent playing style. Her powerful forehand (正手击球), backhand attacks (反手进攻) and great speed make other players feel very stressed. And she is also called "Little Bean Bun" (小豆包) because of her lively and cute side in daily life. Therefore, not only Chinese fans but also fans from other countries fall in love with her. With more than 10 million fans on social media, she has become a role model for the people all over the world.

However, Sun Yingsha's success didn't come easily. She spends a lot of time training every day. Her love for table tennis and strong will have helped her be the top player. She once said that she achieved her success through hard work instead of being a natural genius (天才).

In the future, she will continue to work hard and take part in more international events. We are looking forward to her more excellent performances.

questions.prompt: When was Sun Yingsha born?
questions.translation: 孙颖莎出生于何时？
questions.explanation: 根据第1段 'She was born on November 4th, 2000 in Shijiazhuang, Hebei.' 可知孙颖莎出生于2000年11月4日。故选 On November 4th, 2000.。

questions.prompt: How many medals did Sun win in the 2024 Paris Olympics?
questions.translation: 孙颖莎在2024年巴黎奥运会上获得了多少枚奖牌？
questions.explanation: 根据第2段 'She won two gold medals and one silver medal.' 可知共获得两金一银共3枚奖牌。故选 Three medals.。

questions.prompt: Why do people call Sun "Little Bean Bun"?
options: Because she likes eating bean buns every day.
Because she looks stressed during games.
Because she has a lively and cute side in daily life.
Because she is the youngest table tennis player.
questions.translation: 为什么人们叫孙颖莎“小豆包”？
questions.explanation: 根据第3段 'And she is also called "Little Bean Bun" because of her lively and cute side in daily life.' 可知是因为她在日常生活中活泼可爱。故选 Because she has a lively and cute side in daily life.。

questions.prompt: What can you learn from Sun Yingsha?
options: Winning competitions is the only thing that matters in life.
We should achieve our goals through hard work and a strong will.
Being a natural genius is enough to be successful.
Famous athletes don't need to train every day.
questions.translation: 你可以从孙颖莎身上学到什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第4段 'Her love for table tennis and strong will have helped her be the top player. She once said that she achieved her success through hard work instead of being a natural genius.' 可知，成功的秘诀是通过努力奋斗和坚强意志去实现目标。故选 We should achieve our goals through hard work and a strong will.。
